summary.intent: Coordinate a set of parallel subagent workers to land cleanup and fix PRs in the caliper-docgen repo (trail #243/#244): drop unemitted default-contract items, fix InvalidJson handling in the tsc client, and then start the ADR follow-up work (scope identity, benchmarks banner).
summary.outcome: PRs #371-#376 were opened and merged (main at a6ae3e67). #375 removed ComputedDefault and DefaultSource::JsDoc while keeping JsDocDefaultMismatch, and #376 made unparseable checker replies fail pending requests immediately with InvalidJson. Two new workers (declaration scope identity, benchmarks.md historical banner) were started and had not reported yet.

repo: Cache encodes DiagnosticCode/DefaultSource variants by name, so removing variants does not change existing bytes and CACHE_SCHEMA_VERSION need not be bumped. A bump to 31 failed the golden test cache::golden::source_data_bytes_are_stable_for_the_current_schema_version on the version header alone.
Removing public enum variants in caliper-docgen-core is a Rust API break that `just semver` flags. It is covered by a minor changeset in .changeset/.

Standard verification pipeline: `cargo check --workspace --all-targets`, clean-room detached worktree with `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --offline`, `cargo nextest run --workspace --exclude caliper-docgen-napi --locked`, `just lint doc-check machete typos`, and `just semver`.
The semantic layer maps TscClientError via rpc.rs::classify to CallError::Fatal, and answer_with turns that into a Warning diagnostic, so tsc-client error changes need no semantic-layer edits.
A non-JSON reply body has no request id, so the tsc client can only fail all pending requests rather than one. A garbled notification would also fail waiting requests.
DefaultSource is read only in a test (extractor/tests.rs), so it earns its place only weakly with its remaining Destructuring and DefaultProps variants.

code.finding: Emits JsDocDefaultMismatch when a JSDoc @default differs from the code default, and resolver/tests.rs asserts it. The earlier claim that it was never emitted was wrong. (The worker's report cited ~652, and the orchestrator's rg check found line 634.)
parse_incoming now returns MalformedFrame{InvalidJson} for any body that fails to decode, whether bad JSON or the wrong shape. Its only callers are client.rs dispatch and its own tests.
dispatch now fails every waiting request with the InvalidJson error instead of logging and dropping the frame, which previously ended in a Timeout.

workflow: Verify subagent claims independently with rg before acting on them. The orchestrator's premise about JsDocDefaultMismatch was wrong, and the worker's check caught it.
Prove regression tests fail on pre-fix code by stashing the fix. Unit tests that need the new signature to compile cannot be run pre-fix.
Run tests in a clean-room worktree. The sandboxed worktree showed 43 unexplained failures that passed clean-room, and the sandbox blocks network and ~/.cargo access.
Sequence work by file overlap: independent branches run in parallel, while the SPEC/AC tag re-scan and ADR branches 2-5 touch the same extractor files and must land one at a time.

friction: The original premise that JsDocDefaultMismatch was unemitted was wrong, so the approved removal scope shrank.
43 tests failed in the sandboxed worktree (config, watch_process, snapshots, a_running_process_has_resident_memory) and were never diagnosed.
The sandbox blocked git, gh, entire and some cargo/pnpm steps, so those ran with the sandbox off.
The worker's line reference for chain.rs (~652) differed from the verified line (634).
open_items: Decide whether to keep JsDocDefaultMismatch. This was recommended and effectively kept; the remaining gap is that a default does not record its source.
Release bot PR #291 (0.10.0) is still open and nothing in flight touches the release workflow.
The oracle run the user mentioned is still to be done.
Scope-identity worker (feat/declaration-scope-identity, trail #244) is in flight. It must report peak memory and time on Chakra plus dependencies against main and bumps the cache schema.
Benchmarks banner worker (docs/benchmarks-historical, trail #234) is in flight.
The SPEC/AC tag re-scan is held until the scope-identity PR merges.
ADR branches 2-5 are held and must land one at a time.
The 43 unexplained sandbox-only test failures remain undiagnosed.
